paite: Huan zingsang ahong hih in siampu liante leh vantang upate tengteng Jesu that ding in atungthu ah akihou uhi.
heading: Pilat Ma A Jesu Din Masakna / (Mar 15.1; Luk 23.1,2; Joh 18.28-32)
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

paite: Amah hen in api ua, gam-ukpa Pilat kiang ah api uhi.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

paite: Huan amansakpa Judas in Jesu siam louh tangsak uh ahi chih atheihtak in akisik a, siampu liante leh upate kiang ah dangka sawmthum ahon tawikik hi.
heading: Judas Iskariot Sihna / (Nas 1.18-19)
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

paite: "Midik sisan ka khot thil ka hihkhial,” achi hi. Amau, "Huai kou a ding in bang akhawk dia? Nang na lohloh kiloh in,” achihsan uhi.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

paite: Ama'n huai dangka tempul ah apailut a, paimang in a-awklumta hi.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

paite: Huan siampu liante'n huai dangka ala ua, "Hiai sumbawm a koih asiang kei, sisan man ahi," achi uhi.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

paite: Huchi in akihou ua, mikhualte vuina ding in belvelmi mun aleita uhi.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

paite: Huaiziak in tutan in huai mun, "Sisan mun" achi uhi.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in ana gen, "Amah man ding a Israel suante lak a kuate hiam in asak uh dangka sawmthum alata uh;
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

paite: Toupa'n hon hilh bang in belvelmi mun man ding in apia uh," chih ahong tangtungta hi.
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

paite: Huan gam-ukpa ma ah Jesu adingh hi. Gam-ukpa'n, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" chi in adong hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
heading: Pilat Mai Ah Jesu Adingh / (Mar 15.2-5; Luk 22.3-5; Joh 18.33-38)
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

paite: Siampu liante leh upate'n ahek lai un bangmah in adawng kei hi.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in akiang ah, "Ahon hekna zouzai uh na za kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

paite: Ama'n kam khat lel in leng adawng kei hi; huchi in gam-ukpa'n lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n ankuanglui ni in henta khat, adeihdeih uh, mipite a ding in apawtsak zel hi.
heading: Jesu Si Dia Thutanna / (Mar 15.6-15; Luk 23.13-25; Joh 18.39-19.16)
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

paite: Huai lai in henta minthang, Barabbas achih uh a-om hi.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

paite: Huchi in ahong kikhop un, Pilat in akiang uah, "Kua zaw hon pawtsak leng na ut ua? Barabbas hia, Jesu Khrist kichi?" achi hi.
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

paite: Hazat ziak in amah amansak uh chih athei hi.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

paite: Vaihawmna tutphah a atut lai in, azi in, "Hiai midik tung ah bangmah hih ke'n, tuni'n amah ziak in ka mang in thil tampi ka thuak hi," chi in athukhak hi.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

paite: Huan siampu liante leh upate'n, Barabbas nget a Jesu hihmanthat ding in mipite athuzoh uhi.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

paite: Gam-ukpa'n amau ahoupih a, "Amau nihte akua zaw hon pawtsak leng chi na hi ua?" achi nawn hi.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

paite: Amaute'n, "Barabbas," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Jesu Khrist kichi, bang ka chihta dia le?" achi hi. Avek un, "Amah kilhden in om hen," achi uhi.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou vengvung uhi.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

paite: Huchi in Pilat in bangmah ahihtheita kei a, hong buai deuhdeuh zaw ding chih akitheih in, tui ala a, mipite ma ah akhut asil a, "Hiai midik sisan ah ka siang e; noumau na lohloh uh kiloh un," achi hi.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

paite: Huan mipi tengteng in, "Asisan zaw koumau tung ah leh ka tate uh tung ah om hen," chi in adawng uhi.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

paite: Huai khit in Barabbas apawtsak a; Jesu azep a, kilhden ding in apeta hi.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

paite: Huai khit in, sepaihte'n gam-ukpa inpi ah Jesu apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng akiang ah hong kikhawm uhi.
heading: Sepaihte'n Jesu Soisa Uh / (Mar 15.16-20; Joh 19.2-3)
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

paite: Apuante suahsak in, puan sandup asilhsak uhi.
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

paite: Linglukhu aphan ua, khusak in, akhut taklam in sialluang atawisak ua; ama ah akhukdin ua, "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa," chi in nuihza bawlna in anei uhi.
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

paite: Huan amah achilsiat ua, sialluang laksak in alu akhen uhi.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia aneih khit un, puan asuahsak ua, ama puante asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikheta uhi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

paite: Huan apaikhiak lai un, Kurini a mi, amin Simon amu ua; huai mi ama kros po ding in aman uhi.
heading: Jesu Kilhdenna / (Mar 15.21-32; Luk 23.26-43; Joh 19.17-27)
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

paite: Golgotha mun ahong tun un, huai tuh Luguh mun chihna ahi,
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

paite: uain thuk, thil kha toh hel, dawn ding in apia ua, himahleh acheptak in adawn nuam kei hi.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

paite: Akilhden khit un, ai san in apuansilh akihawm uhi.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

paite: Huan huai ah tu in avengta uhi.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

paite: Ahekna uh, "HIAI JUDATE' KUMPIPA JESU AHI," chi a gelh, alutung ah asuang uhi.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Amah toh, suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat leh aveilam ah khat akilhden uhi.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

paite: Huan mi vialvak peuh in alu uh sinkhum in,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

paite: "Nang tempul hihsia a ni thum a lam nawnpa, kihihdam in; Pathian Tapa na hihleh kros a kipan hong kumsuk tanla," chi in a-enghou uhi.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

paite: Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, enghou in,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

paite: "Midangte hondampa, amah-le-amah kihondam theiloupi in, Israelte kumpipa ahih ngalleh tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh a kei dia, huchi in amah i gingta mai ding.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

paite: Pathian amuang na aka, amah zaw a-utleh tu in kihondamleh ake; Pathian Tapa ka hi, achi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

paite: Suamhat akilhden un leng, huchi mah bang in a-enghou hi.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

paite: Huan dak gukna a kipan dak kuana tan in khua ahong mialvekta hi.
heading: Jesu Sihna / (Mar 15.33-41; Luk 23.44-49; Joh 19,28-30)
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

paite: Dak kuana ding in, aw ngaihtak in, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in Jesu akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, ka Pathian bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

paite: Akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, “Hiai mi'n Elijah sam ahi," achi uhi.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

paite: Alak ua mi khat kintak in atai pah a, spanji ala a, uain thuk diahdim in chiang ah asuang a, adawnsak hi.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

paite: Midangte'n, "Ngaihsak kei un, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong pai hiam i en ding uh,” achi uhi.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

paite: Jesu ngaihtak in akikou nawn a, akha akhahta hi.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

paite: Huan ngai dih, tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam tan in hong keksuakta a; ziin ahong ling a, suangpite khangkham in; hante ahong kihong hi.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

paite: Mi Siangthou ihmusate pumpi tampi leng kaihthoh in a-omta uhi.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

paite: Huaite athohnawn nung in, han a kipan hong pawt in kho siangthou ah alut ua, mi tampi lak ah akilakta uhi.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

paite: Huan sepaih zaheutu leh akiang a Jesu veng a omte'n, zinling leh thil omdante amuh un alau mahmah ua, "Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi uhi.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

paite: Huai ah, numei tampi, a-nna sepsak kawm zel a Galili gam a kipan a hon zuite a-om ua, gamlapi ah a-en uhi.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

paite: Huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob leh Joseph nu Mari leh Zebedai tapate' nute a-om uhi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, Arimathai khua a mihausa, amin Joseph ahong pai a, amah leng Jesu nungzui ahi sam hi.
heading: Jesu Vuina / (Mar 15.42-47; Luk 23.50-56; Joh 19.38-42)
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

paite: Huai mi Pilat kiang ah ava hoh a, Jesu luang angen hi. Pilat in piak ding in thu apia hi.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

paite: Huchi in Joseph in aluang ala a, puanmalngat siangtak in atuam hi.
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

paite: Ama hankhuk thak, suang khuakkuak ah asial a; suang lianpi in hankhuk kongkhak adelh a, apaita hi.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

paite: Huan huai ah Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang a-om ua, hankhuk mazawn ah atu uhi.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

paite: Huan azing in, huai tuh, kisakkholhna zoh ni zing ahi a, Pilat kiang ah siampu liante leh Pharisaite a-omkhawm kheukhou uhi.
heading: Hankhuk Veng Ding A Thu Piakna
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

paite: "Pu, huai mikhemhat in adam lai in, ni thum nung in ka thounawn ding, achih ka theigige uhi.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

paite: Huchi in ani thum ni tanpha hankhuk venghoih ding in thu pia in; huchi lou in zaw anungzuite'n amah ava gukhe ding ua, vantang kiang ah, misi lak a kipan athounawnta achi kha ding uh; huchi in khemna nanung zaw amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw sem ding," achi uhi.
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

paite: Pilat in akiang uah, "Vengmi sepaihte na nei ve ua oi; pai unla, na hihtheih bang un venghoihsakta unla," achi hi.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

paite: Huchi in vengmi sepaihte toh ava hoh ua, hankhuk avenghoihsak ua, hansuang achiamteh uhi.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
